summary: Recent discussions in the Parquet community focus on revising size recommendations for row groups and page sizes, with proposals to drop the 8 KB page size guideline and to adjust row group sizes for object storage. Additional threads evaluate encoding performance, noting FastLanes and PFOR deliver high decode throughput, and address ambiguities in the FILE logical type when both inline data and URI are present. A proposal to include uncompressed page sizes in the OffsetIndex aims to help readers bound memory usage ahead of time.

highlights.text: Revising the Parquet row group size recommendation to better suit object storage, moving away from the outdated 512 MB–1 GB guideline.
Removing the 8 KB page size recommendation from the documentation, citing its inadequacy for compression and proposing a larger default.
Benchmarking FastLanes and PFOR encodings, showing high decode throughput and compression ratios, and agreeing to include them in Parquet.
